company.description:
Pulse Q&A is an internet company that empowers CIOs to make innovation and spend decisions based on crowdsourced data. The company gives its users access to relevant conversations and data, they can now make decisions that actually move the needle.

Pulse Q&A was founded in 2017 and headquartered in California, United States.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $6,500,000, or 61.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,531,714 to $27,207,535, a 6x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
